textRuns.value: ⚠ GROSS supply-risk figures (per DEC-001). Not official EU CRM Supply Risk values — recycling (EoL_RIR) and substitution (SI_SR) risk-reducing filters are out of scope. Governance + trade weighting reorders material risk vs plain concentration; it compresses (does not inflate) the absolute HHI.

Contrast = EU-sourcing HHI ÷ global HHI. Above 1.0 means Europe sources this material more narrowly than the world produces it. Materials with global supply but no EU sourcing rows are BLANK, never 0 — 0 would read as "perfectly diffuse supply", the safest possible value, for the case where coverage is missing.
